revision_policy: V3.1 identifies the supplied source document; record and compare the physical PCB before HIL

console.electrical: MCU pins use 3.3 V UART; the board RS232 connector is behind MAX232/P14 jumpers and requires a matching RS232 adapter, not a TTL adapter

spi.reason: No SPI resource allocation is bound in this baseline

rs485.reason: DE/RE routing and jumper state require a verified board resource profile

external_flash.policy: The manual contains a W25Qxx example; do not assume exact fitted part or assign it a storage partition

safe_outputs.leds: Preload all three active-low LEDs high before output mode
safe_outputs.industrial_actuators: No external actuator pins are configured or claimed safe
